description: Critical/high OSV advisories in the shipped OpenCode CLI closure that cannot be fixed without an upstream dependency bump. Every entry needs a reason and an expiry; the gate fails when an expiry passes while the advisory is still reachable.

scope.rationale: Production dependency closure of the CLI that the native Termux build bundles. Dev-only workspaces and tooling are out of scope.

entries.reason: solid-js SSR/hydration serializer. Audit bundle extraction confirmed seroval is absent from the shipped CLI. Fixed in seroval 1.6.3; the pinned solid-js resolution requires an upstream bump.

Reached through build/install-time glob expansion (babel-plugin-module-resolver -> glob -> minimatch). The process-instruction guard rejects amplified patterns before expansion, whichever minimatch copy handles them. Fix requires an upstream lockfile refresh.

This copy expands project `instructions` globs at startup, so the call-site budget in instruction.ts rejects amplified patterns before expansion. Fixed in 5.0.12, which is within minimatch's range; a lockfile refresh upstream clears it.
Install-time npm registry cache logic via @npmcli/arborist -> npm-registry-fetch. Not part of the shipped CLI bundle, and OSV lists no fixed release. Re-evaluate when arborist updates.

Runtime frontmatter parsing via gray-matter, bounded by the 64 KiB frontmatter budget applied by the config guard. Fixed in js-yaml 3.15.2, but gray-matter pins the 3.x line and the fix needs an upstream bump. Re-evaluate at expiry.
Reached only through install-time node-gyp tooling. Under Bun, bare `undici` imports resolve to the runtime builtin rather than this npm copy. Fix requires an upstream lockfile refresh.

@effect/platform-node Node HTTP fallback. Bun resolves the bare `undici` specifier to its own builtin, so the compiled CLI never loads this npm copy. Fix requires an upstream @effect/platform-node refresh.
Pinned transitively by gitlab-ai-provider. Fixed in zod 4.6.6, which is outside the provider's supported range; requires an upstream bump.
Pinned by @opencode/core in the upstream 2.1.4 lockfile. Fixed in zod 4.6.6; requires an upstream dependency bump.
Pinned transitively by @modelcontextprotocol/client. Fixed in zod 4.6.6, which is outside the client's supported range; requires an upstream bump.
